name: mvnpdf
expr: y1 = mvnpdf(X); y2 = mvnpdf(X, mu1); y3 = mvnpdf(X, [0 0], Sigma); s_def = mvnpdf([0 0]); s_1d = mvnpdf(1, 0, 1);
comment: Sig: p = mvnpdf(X[, mu[, Sigma]]). Multivariate normal PDF. Defaults: mu=zeros, Sigma=I. Cholesky-based |Σ|^(-1/2) and Σ^(-1) for numerical stability. Verified bit-identical to MATLAB R2025b on default / explicit mu / explicit Σ paths.
